import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']
s6_trips = trips[trips['fished_date_season'] == 6].copy()

# Define windows
early = s6_trips[(s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 14) & (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 60)]
spring = s6_trips[(s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 85) & (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 120)]
fall = s6_trips[(s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] >= 150) & (s6_trips['fished_date_doy'] <= 220)]

print("=== S6 SEASONAL WINDOWS ===\n")

print("EARLY PEAK (DOY 14-60) - I MISSED THIS:")
early_cls = early.groupby('cls').agg({'yt': 'sum', 'anglers': 'sum'}).round(2)
early_cls['yt_per_angler'] = (early_cls['yt'] / early_cls['anglers']).round(3)
early_cls = early_cls.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)
print(early_cls)

print("\nSPRING TAIL (DOY 85-120) - I CAUGHT THIS:")
spring_cls = spring.groupby('cls').agg({'yt': 'sum', 'anglers': 'sum'}).round(2)
spring_cls['yt_per_angler'] = (spring_cls['yt'] / spring_cls['anglers']).round(3)
spring_cls = spring_cls.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)
print(spring_cls)

print("\nFALL PEAK (DOY 150-220) - FUTURE TARGET:")
fall_cls = fall.groupby('cls').agg({'yt': 'sum', 'anglers': 'sum'}).round(2)
fall_cls['yt_per_angler'] = (fall_cls['yt'] / fall_cls['anglers']).round(3)
fall_cls = fall_cls.sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False)
print(fall_cls)

print("\n=== KEY INSIGHT FOR S7 ===")
print(f"Early peak multi_day (8.86 yt/angler) >> Spring tail three_quarter (1.77 yt/angler)")
print(f"Missing 2-3 multi_day trips in early peak cost me ~7-10 fish")
print(f"Must activate strategy.py on DOY 1 to catch early peak immediately")
